parameters.text:
={{
`
You are classifying events for the Gudpals senior-citizen community website.

Analyze the event and determine:
1. Whether it is clearly relevant to senior citizens or their community.
2. Which Gudpals website section it belongs to.

Event:
Title: ${$json.title}
Date: ${$json.date}
Time: ${$json.time}
Venue: ${$json.venue}
City: ${$json.city}
Organiser: ${$json.organiser}
Description: ${$json.description}

Choose exactly ONE category from these six options:

- Meetups & Socials
  Use for meetups, social gatherings, community gatherings, networking, clubs, and senior citizen associations.

- Events & Shows
  Use for concerts, music shows, theatre, comedy shows, cultural events, performances, and entertainment events.

- Tours & Escapes
  Use for tours, trips, travel groups, retreats, sightseeing, heritage tours, nature trips, and getaways.

- Fun Activities
  Use for games, karaoke, hobbies, recreational activities, workshops, dance, arts, crafts, and other fun activities.

- Health & Wellness
  Use for yoga, meditation, fitness, health camps, medical awareness, wellness programs, therapy, and senior health activities.

- Stores
  Use for products, shops, shopping, senior-friendly products, services, and businesses intended for the senior community.

Rules:
- is_senior_event must be true or false.
- Only mark true when the event is clearly relevant to senior citizens or their community.
- Do not guess that an event is for seniors just because it is located near seniors or has general relevance.
- category must be exactly one of the six categories listed above.
- Do not create a new category.
- summary must be maximum 40 words.
- Return ONLY valid JSON.

Return exactly this format:

{
  "is_senior_event": true,
  "category": "Health & Wellness",
  "reason": "Short reason",
  "summary": "Maximum 40-word summary"
}
`
}}
